# Craftbid

> A Philippine marketplace where people commission handmade work from Filipino
> craft artists: crochet, weaving, pottery, embroidery and more.

A client posts a craft request with a starting budget in pesos and reference
photos. Artists bid privately, each with a message and portfolio samples; no
artist can see another artist's bid. The client picks one, which opens a
commission, and pays the artist directly (half down, half after delivery or at
a meet-up). Craftbid records each payment but never holds the money. Both sides
review each other when the work is finished.

## Pages
- https://craftbid-6w5p.onrender.com/: work from artists, and open requests
- https://craftbid-6w5p.onrender.com/postings: open craft requests
- https://craftbid-6w5p.onrender.com/discover: portfolio work by artists
- https://craftbid-6w5p.onrender.com/register: join as a client or an artist
